parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` — `makePlaycut` in `NowPlayingInfoCenterManagerTests.swift` (line 31) and `makeTestPlaycut` in `NowPlayingWidgetTests.swift` (line 113). Per the restraint rules, any cluster where even one record is a test fixture warrants no-action; here both are test helpers whose similarity (Jaccard 0.818) is incidental to their role as local factory functions for test data. Merging them into a shared generic factory would couple two independent test suites and obscure the intent of each fixture.
